This directory contains unmodified contract sources from Asuswrt-Merlin
3004.388.12_2, commit 433fc608f5fc1689f3d3c3ab5cd2a7d57102260f.

The libovpn source files carry the GNU GPL version 2 or later notice.
Their original copyright and license headers are retained.
COPYING-GPL-2.0.txt provides the GPL text. Exact source URLs and SHA256
are recorded in sources.json.

The private prototype uses the original image libovpn, libshared and
OpenSSL libraries without modifying their bytes. Component license
notices are retained in sources/localmod/MERLIN_COMPONENTS_NOTICE.txt
and the pinned upstream source tree referenced by sources.json.
The source archive intentionally does not include vendor firmware,
toolchains, generated credentials or a flashable firmware image.
